title: Maximum Security
steps: The control room: open Monitors
Monitors: look at Camera feeds
Go back to The control room
The control room: open Guard
Guard: look at Badge
Go back to The control room
The control room: open Desk
Desk: Drawer lock → solve "Drawer lock" (answer: 586)
Desk: Drawer → get Scissors, Code folder
Go back to The control room
The control room: open Guard
Guard: use Scissors on Key card → get Key card
Go back to The control room
The control room: open Shelf
Shelf: Flashlight → get Flashlight
Go back to The control room
The control room: open Fire box
Fire box: use Flashlight on Break glass
Fire box: Fire extinguisher → get Fire extinguisher
Go back to The control room
The control room: open Steel door
Steel door: use Fire extinguisher on Doorway
Steel door: Laser panel → solve "Laser panel" (answer: 🟢 🔴 🟡 🔵)
Steel door: use Key card on Card reader
Steel door: Keypad → solve "Hourly code" (answer: 6158)
Steel door: Out to the yard
